title: GPT Image gets the dimensions and quality you request
summary:
Image requests got more precise, media routes got less surprising, and community models gained health controls.

Community contributions changed `gpt-image-2` to accept requested dimensions within its supported bounds rather than snapping to three presets, and raised its input-image resize cap to 3840px per edge. GPT Image quality settings now pass through as requested, with `hd` mapped to provider-supported `high`.

Chat-completion audio responses now carry valid WAV size fields and the correct content type when the output is WAV. GET `/video/models` returns the existing image and video model list instead of entering the video-generation route.

Fireworks-routed text and embedding requests received a reliability fix. Non-streaming chat completions now accept upstream responses without a `model` field, and Bedrock Claude requests no longer send `top_p` alongside `temperature`, a combination Bedrock rejects.
